name: John Mazarakis
current_role: CEO and Co-Executive Chairman, Vireo Growth Inc.; Executive Chairman, Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance (REFI); co-founder/partner, Chicago Atlantic Group
profile: Chicago-based entrepreneur who co-founded Chicago Atlantic Group (2019), a private-credit manager best known as a leading lender to state-licensed US cannabis operators, and has chaired its mortgage REIT REFI since its Dec 2021 IPO. Since Dec 2024 he has run Vireo Growth, building a multi-state cannabis operator platform. BA Economics (Delaware), MBA (Chicago Booth).
interesting_fact: In Dec 2024 he moved from lender to operator: as part of the Chicago Atlantic/Lineage merger deals he became CEO of Vireo Growth with a mandate to build the first comprehensive platform for cannabis operators.
deep_cut_fact: Before finance, he was a restaurant and real-estate operator: he built a 30+ restaurant chain with more than 1,200 employees, assembled a 30+ property real estate portfolio and developed over 1 million sq ft of commercial real estate.
notes: Low public profile beyond cannabis-finance trade press (e.g. Business of Cannabis Q&A, Benzinga Cannabis Conference speaker). Best route: Chicago Atlantic general inbox or Vireo IR. Energy/data-center angle is weak.
